facts: Mihomo Hysteria2Option has no disable-mtu-discovery or disable-path-mtu-discovery field.
Mihomo constructs a quic.Config with only the four receive-window fields.
sing-quic NewClient sets DisablePathMTUDiscovery from operating system, overriding any incoming value. On Windows the resulting value is false.

QUIC PMTU discovery controls packets sent by the endpoint containing that configuration. A client-only change would not directly lower the server's download packet size. ACK-path effects may exist but would need evidence.

udp_mtu.scope: Proxied application UDP datagram fragmentation in HY2 udpPacketConn. Fast HTTPS/TCP uses DialConn QUIC streams and does not use this option.

bandwidth_negotiation.source_confirmed_behavior: Official server ignores requested client RX bandwidth and uses its configured congestion controller when IgnoreClientBandwidth is true. Merely adding client down/up fields does not force server download Brutal.

decision: Do not run a guessed Mihomo client disable-MTU-discovery trial or change udp-mtu for the Fast TCP throughput issue. Current cross-protocol and fresh-client measurements motivate examining the client-to-VPS path; they do not by themselves identify ISP throttling or a specific route fault.
